definitions.explanation: Additional value created through processing, service, or enhancement. Used in business and economics for the extra worth added to a product or service beyond its raw cost.

examples.japanese: {付加価値|ふかかち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開発|かいはつ}→開発：06746_kaihatsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦サービス→サービス：01531_saabisu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{付加価値|ふかかち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{付|つ}ける→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{重要|じゅうよう}→重要：01575_juuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: It's important to add value to services.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{素材|そざい}→素材：09492_sozai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧{付加価値|ふかかち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{生|う}み{出|だ}す→生み出す：10423_umidasu⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{地方|ちほう}→地方：02369_chihou⟧⟦{経済|けいざい}→経済：01394_keizai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{活性化|かっせいか}→活性化：07563_kasseika⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧つながる。
examples.english: Creating high-value-added products using local materials leads to the revitalization of regional economies.

notes:
Compound of {付加|ふか} (addition) + ⟦{価値|かち}→価値：00131_kachi⟧ (value). A key term in business and economics.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {付加価値|ふかかち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧ (high-value-added)
- {付加価値|ふかかち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{付|つ}ける→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧ (to add value)
- {付加価値|ふかかち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{生|う}む→生む：29531_umu⟧ (to generate added value)
- {付加価値|ふかかち}{税|ぜい} (value-added tax, VAT)

USAGE:
{付加価値|ふかかち}{税|ぜい} is the formal term for VAT. In Japan, the equivalent is ⟦{消費|しょうひ}{税|ぜい}→消費税：04803_shouhizei⟧ (consumption tax), though {付加価値|ふかかち}{税|ぜい} is used when discussing tax systems internationally.
